Meaning: Runs inference (TRUE) or acts as a transparent passthrough (FALSE)
Multimodel config file ("[multimodel]" defaults/behavior plus per-sensor "[stream-model-<id>]" bindings) parsed by the plugin; individual properties override values from it
Maximum number of concurrent streams, sizing every internal mux; 0 inherits from the config file/default and should match the upstream streammux batch
nvinfer batch size for a single model instance (0 uses batch-size); streams beyond this auto-shard onto additional same-model instances
Combines primary and shadow outputs into one batched buffer for an A/B view

Blocks the pipeline's transition to PLAYING until the configured default model(s) are warmed, so defaults run inference from the first frame (mirrors nvinfer); FALSE warms them asynchronously and streams passthrough until ready

When a model goes idle as a lone redundant warm copy, moves it out of its role pool (primary/shadow) into a shared limbo pool so a later request from either role reuses that warm copy, keeping fewer warm copies overall; applies only when no twin already exists, and the configured default model is never moved
Default PRIMARY model as "name;version;config-file" (config-file required; name defaults to its basename, version optional); required to enable inference
Optional default SHADOW model (A/B) as "name;version;config-file"; unset means no shadow

Enables automatic sharding of streams across model instances. TRUE (default): overflow streams beyond the per-model batch cap are distributed onto new same-model shard instances. FALSE: streams exceeding the cap are silently ignored, matching stock nvinfer behavior
